summary: The MaintClinicalPracticeCodes module is designed to handle the maintenance and management of clinical practice codes within the system. It supports adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating entries related to clinical practice codes.
purpose: To manage clinical practice codes by supporting operations such as add, edit, delete, and reactivate, while maintaining system access control and validation.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for clinical practice codes.

workflows.name: Manage Clinical Practice Codes
steps: CheckScreenAccess to determine if current user has edit rights.
Add new clinical practice code if ID is 0, else update existing code.
Reactivate or delete entry based on user command.

business_rules: Screen access is determined by user roles: SystemAdministrator and LocalAdministrator.
Add operation is prohibited if department or program dropdowns are empty.
conditions: User must have edit rights determined by ScreenIsEditable flag.
Check for the presence of agencies, departments, and programs before allowing add operations.
system_behavior: Grid displays error messages when no data is found and manages add/edit commands.
User interface elements like panels and buttons are dynamically shown/hidden based on user actions.
dependencies: User session management for user access control.
Data sources for agency, department, and program selection.
exceptions: Null grid row entries when attempting to edit or delete could lead to system errors.
